symptom: Chief Engineer generated 0/3 blueprints and the strict completion DTO rejected build verifier coverage that referenced OBL-DELIVERY-DEPTH, which was not an artifact or entrypoint obligation.
exact_error: invalid project completion contract: verifier 'OBL-VERIFY-BUILD' references unknown obligation ids ['OBL-DELIVERY-DEPTH']
root_cause: The CE authority normalizer rebuilt environment, test, and entrypoint verifier coverage from committed PM authority, but preserved raw build/lint covers_obligation_ids. Provider acceptance labels therefore leaked into the strict completion obligation namespace and caused a late DTO failure.

fix.policy: At the CE authority boundary, retain only build/lint coverage ids that name normalized canonical artifact or entrypoint obligations. If provider advice contains aliases only, bind coverage to all required non-doc, non-test PM-authorized artifacts. Keep ProjectCompletionContractV1 strict for callers bypassing the authority boundary.

dynamic_replay.mode: exact persisted candidate plus exact final semantic patch

secondary_audit_gap: The bench audit labeled this failure M06_director_multi_task even though Director never ran. Primary attribution must use the first authoritative failing phase before downstream residual signatures.
residual_risk: Fresh isolated Bench is required because provider output may expose a later independent CE or Director defect after this blocker is removed.
